how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'validate'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
arguments:

  "arguments": [

      "help": "Model ref: module:Class"
    },
    {

      "default": "null",
